top_signals.title: Stock Resiliency Depends on Moves by the Fed, Says Principal’s Shah
top_signals.summary: “The next couple of months are likely to be pretty rocky with only modest gains to be had for the rest of the year,” says Seema Shah, chief global strategist at Principal Asset Management. Shah says a possible series of hikes by the Federal Reserve can provide some resistance for equities. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Singapore Air Defended by Government on Air India, Expansion
top_signals.summary: The Singapore government is backing Singapore Airlines investment in foreign carriers, including its financial support for loss-making Air India, as the company seeks to strengthen its position abroad.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Franklin Templeton to Acquire Real Assets Firm Stoneshield
top_signals.summary: Franklin Templeton Inc. is buying a majority stake in Stoneshield Capital, a European investment firm specializing in real estate and infrastructure, in the latest move by the US money manager to expand further into alternative assets.
